# TrailFusion AI

> TrailFusion AI is the indie app studio of Hiroaki Yuasa. It makes apps for learning, talking, travelling and creating. The flagship is Gokaku! Quest, one study app with 18 courses for Japanese junior-high and university entrance exams, certifications, languages and driving theory.

Updated: 2026-11-15
Website: https://trailfusionai.com/ (Japanese) and https://trailfusionai.com/en/ (English)
Contact: trailfusionai@gmail.com
App Store publisher name: hiroaki yuasa

## Key facts (App Store Japan, 2026-10-25)
- Apps on the App Store: 12 (as of 2026-10-25); Mochi was released on 2026-11-06.
- App Store ratings across all apps: 262.
- Gokaku! Quest: 18 courses as of 2026-11-21. Current course scope and availability: https://trailfusionai.com/quest/ .

## Apps
- [Gokaku! Quest](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/) — Entrance-exam science, social studies, Japanese and math, plus certifications and languages. 18 courses in one app. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6775411516
- [Mochi](https://trailfusionai.com/mochi.html) — A soft companion to talk with. Put feelings into words and spend a little time together every day. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6826491845
- [Car Concierge](https://trailfusionai.com/car-concierge.html) — Where to rest tonight, parking fees, EV charging and the next destination, on a single map for road trips in Japan. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6751795223
- [Reel Make](https://trailfusionai.com/reelmake.html) — Pick photos and clips. AI builds a vertical video with narration and captions. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6779420680
- [VoiceLink AI Translator](https://trailfusionai.com/voicelink.html) — Speech recognition, translation and summaries run entirely on the device. Nothing you say is sent to a server. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6746684736
- [BuddyTalk](https://trailfusionai.com/buddytalk.html) — English practice with AI characters. Public version: 1.4.6. Version 2.0.0 is being prepared for App Review, with on-device learning after initial setup, 500 free beginner Community Talk scenes and 1,500 two-/three-person scenarios. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6744263274
- [English Quest](https://trailfusionai.com/eigo-quest.html) — Grammar, vocabulary and English exams, learned through quizzes and explanations. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782028599
- [Gokaku! FP Quest](https://trailfusionai.com/fp-quest.html) — The six areas of the Japanese financial planner exam, with illustrated guides and questions. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812542387
- [Word Blaster](https://trailfusionai.com/word-blaster.html) — Words fly at you as enemies. A vocabulary shooter for 10 languages. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6745741796
- [Wood Golem](https://trailfusionai.com/wood-golem.html) — A strategy puzzle built on the classic stick-taking game, with a golem who grows as you win. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6739466549
- [Hacking Timer](https://trailfusionai.com/hacking-timer.html) — An interval timer for Apple Watch that keeps a rhythm of focus and rest. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6746063846

## BuddyTalk — version 2.0.1 (public, updated 2026-11-15)
BuddyTalk is an English-learning app from TrailFusion AI. As of 2026-11-15 the public App Store version is 2.0.1 (released 2026-11-07). App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6744263274

- English practice with AI characters: 1,500 Community Talk scenarios at levels 1–10, with 750 for the learner and one AI character and 750 for the learner and two AI characters. The 500 beginner scenarios at levels 1–5 are free. Lessons, stories and grammar steps also support English practice. These are role-plays with AI, not live chats with other users.
- Free and Pro: the free version includes conversation lessons 1–2, grammar step 1, beginner stories and Community Talk levels 1–5, plus learning support for the first three replies of every conversation. BuddyTalk Pro adds all lessons, grammar and stories, Community Talk levels 6–10, and learning support, pass and translation for every reply. Prices and details are shown in the app and on the App Store.
- Language support: English remains the practice language. Guidance uses 10 languages in 11 settings: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, French (France or Canada), German, Spanish, Korean, Hindi, Brazilian Portuguese and Russian.
- Device requirements, downloads and offline conditions: see the product page and the App Store listing.

Sources: [Japanese product page](https://trailfusionai.com/buddytalk.html), [English product page](https://trailfusionai.com/en/buddytalk.html), [Privacy Policy](https://trailfusionai.com/buddytalk-privacy.html#en), [Terms of Use](https://trailfusionai.com/buddytalk-terms.html#en)

## 日本語の要約（2026-11-15）
合格！クエスト（TrailFusion AI・提供者名 hiroaki yuasa）は、中学受験（小学4〜6年生）の理科・社会・国語・算数を、過去の入試の出題傾向を分析して作ったオリジナルの一問一答（4択・偏差値の目安で40・50・60・70の4段階）で復習する学習アプリです。まちがえた問題をためて解き直せるので、入試直前の暗記の仕上げに向いています。同じアプリで資格・語学（ITパスポート・FP・簿記・宅建士・SPI3・日本語・英語・運転免許）も学べます。iPhone・iPad（App Store）とAndroid（Google Play）で配信。ダウンロード無料・アプリ内課金あり。塾や過去問演習の代わりではなく、復習と確認の補助教材で、合格を保証するものではありません。

### 中学受験の科目別ガイド
- [中学受験 理科・社会・国語・算数アプリ（総合）](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/)
- [中学受験 理科アプリ](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/science/)：36単元・7,742問。生命・地球・物質・エネルギー。
- [中学受験 社会アプリ](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/social/)：53単元・5,327問。地理・歴史・公民。
- [中学受験 国語アプリ](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/kokugo/)：94単元・4,550問。語彙・ことわざ慣用句・漢字・ことばのきまり・読解。
- [中学受験 算数アプリ](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/math/)：55単元・6,600問。数と計算・変化と関係・データの活用・図形・文章題。
- [中学受験 暗記アプリ](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/anki/)：4択で思い出し、まちがい直しで定着。
- [よくある質問](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/faq/)、[料金・購入ガイド](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/plans/)、[中学受験4科](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/school4/)
数は2026年10月25日確認の収録データ（無料・Pro対象を含む）。各問題は偏差値の目安で40・50・60・70の4段階（難易度区分であり模試の偏差値とは別）。

### 入試直前の要点ガイド（2026-11-15）
- [中学受験 理科 植物のまとめ](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/science-plants/)：花のつくり・種子と発芽・光合成と蒸散・道管と師管。
- [中学受験 理科 動物・人体のまとめ](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/science-animals/)：こん虫・セキツイ動物・消化・血液と呼吸。
- [中学受験 社会 暗記の直前ガイド](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/social-anki/)：地理・歴史・公民のよく問われる型。
- [中学受験 直前2か月の理科・社会 暗記の進め方](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/last-2-months/)：時期ごとの計画・1日15〜20分の量の目安・まちがい直し。

- 以前の「合格！社会クエスト」のストア掲載ページは、現在は統合版です。
- 単体アプリの購入と学習記録は、アプリ内の案内に沿って統合版へ引き継げます。

### 無料とPro
ダウンロード無料・アプリ内課金あり。利用できる問題・機能・プランは教材や配信版によって異なります。現在の利用範囲と価格はアプリ内の案内・購入画面でご確認ください。

### 資格・語学（別セクション）
合格！クエストでは宅建士・FP・日商簿記・ITパスポート・SPI3・日本語（JLPT・JFT-Basic対策）・英語（TOEIC・TOEFLなど）・運転免許（学科）も学べます。 [中学受験・資格・語学等の教材一覧](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/#courses)

## English summary of the Japanese-language entrance-exam courses
Gokaku! Quest teaches the four school subjects of Japanese junior-high entrance exams (grades 4 to 6) with original one-question-per-screen four-choice quizzes built from an analysis of past exam trends, a mistakes review and a kingdom-building map that grows as you study.
- Science: 36 units, 7,742 questions. https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/science/
- Social studies: 53 units, 5,327 questions. https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/social/
- Japanese language: 94 units, 4,550 questions. https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/kokugo/
- Math: 55 units, 6,600 questions. https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/math/
- Questions come in four difficulty bands labelled 40, 50, 60 and 70 (a difficulty label, not a mock-exam deviation score). Band 40 (the easiest band of each unit) is free; 50, 60 and 70 are Pro. Prices are shown on the app's purchase screen.
- Pre-exam guides for the last two months before the exams (Japanese): plants https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/science-plants/ , animals and the human body https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/science-animals/ , social studies memorization https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/social-anki/ , and a two-month study plan https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/last-2-months/
- It is a review aid, not a replacement for cram school or past-paper practice, and it does not guarantee admission.
- Single-subject predecessors: Gokaku Rika Quest (science) and Gokaku! Kokugo Quest (Japanese language). Their purchases and progress can move to Gokaku! Quest from inside the app.
- Figures as of 2026-10-25 (release manifest). App Store Japan rating 4.37 from 114 ratings (2026-10-27).

<!-- quest-growth:facts:start -->## 合格！クエストの学習目的別ガイド（2026-11-21確認）

合格！クエストは、中学受験4科、大学受験6科目、資格・就職5教材、語学2教材、運転免許の18教材を選べる学習アプリです。ダウンロード無料、アプリ内課金あり。問題、図鑑、画像、読み上げ、プランの利用範囲は教材と配信版で異なるため、アプリ内の案内を確認してください。

- [中学受験4科](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/juken/)：理科・社会・国語・算数。従来の教科別ページを継続。
- [大学受験の6科目](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/university/)：情報Ⅰ・数学ⅠA・地理・日本史・化学・物理。独自作成の問題・解説を使う復習用教材で、過去問集ではありません。
- [資格・就職](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/qualifications/)：宅建士・FP・簿記・ITパスポート・SPI3。
- [大学受験 情報Ⅰ](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/university/information/)：45単元。情報社会・情報デザイン・コンピュータ・データ活用。用語だけでなく、しくみや考え方を問題で確認します。
- [大学受験 数学ⅠA](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/university/math-ia/)：52単元。数と式、関数、図形、データ、場合の数と確率。解き方の筋道を確かめながら、苦手な単元を復習します。
- [大学受験 地理](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/university/geography/)：55単元。地図・自然環境・産業・人口・地誌。地域の特徴や資料の読み取りを、単元別の問題で確かめます。
- [大学受験 日本史](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/university/japanese-history/)：60単元。原始・古代から近現代まで。史料の読み方や、政治・社会・文化のつながりを問題で復習します。
- [大学受験 化学](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/university/chemistry/)：52単元。物質の構成と状態、化学反応、無機物質、有機化合物など。用語と現象をつなげ、単元ごとに理解を確かめます。
- [大学受験 物理](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/university/physics/)：55単元。力学、熱、波、電気・磁気、原子など。現象と法則の関係を整理し、苦手な単元から問題で復習します。

受験する試験の全範囲の網羅や合格・得点向上を保証するものではありません。以前の12教材・99,075問・6,074図鑑ページという数値は2026年10月25日の旧スナップショットであり、18教材の現在の合計ではありません。

<!-- quest-expansion:language-facts:start -->## Global language-learning scope (2026-11-21)

Japanese Quest (japanese-everyday) and English Quest (english-travel) are the two Gokaku Quest courses for international learners. They are courses in the same app, not separate downloads. English explanations are supported; lessons, images, audio, explanation languages and purchase options vary by content, OS and version. Japanese entrance-exam and qualification courses use Japanese. Do not describe all 18 courses as available in English.

- [Compare the two language courses](https://trailfusionai.com/en/quest/)
- [Japanese Quest](https://trailfusionai.com/en/japanese-quest.html): everyday Japanese A1–B1, JLPT N5–N1 study tracks and JFT-Basic study track. Learning language: Japanese.
- [English Quest](https://trailfusionai.com/en/eigo-quest.html): phonics, vocabulary, grammar, conversation expressions, idioms, reading and writing topics. Learning language: English.
- [日本語の語学教材ガイド](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/languages/)

The Japanese university-entrance section lists the six released courses: Information I, Math IA, Geography, Japanese History, Chemistry and Physics. Its 319 listed entries consist of 315 learning units and four original Math IA mock tests. These are Japanese-language supplementary study materials, not a claim of complete exam coverage. Public Affairs / Politics and Economics is not advertised as released.

Free download with in-app purchases. Do not infer that every feature or lesson is free or included in one plan. A website translation does not mean every course is translated. This file is supplementary; the public HTML pages are the primary source.
